messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up for the regional failover. Three recurring issues: flappy route announcements, snapshot metadata mismatches, unclear game-day roles. Need owners + dates. Keep replies short.

kevin: I'll own routing guardrails. Deliverable: staged withdraws + route-convergence metric. PR by 2026-03-06, canary the following day.

sasha: I'll rewrite the restore runbook into a checklist with exact commands and expected outputs. Draft by 2026-03-03.

anil: I'll ship a snapshot verifier that does checksum + tiny restore in staging. Nightly EU cadence. ETA: 8 business days.

ops-runbooks: Runbook snippet to include:
- Preconditions: snapshot <24h, ops oncall pinged.
- Step 1: quiesce writes: ``curl -X POST https://api/reconfig/maintenance``
- Step 2: restore: ``./restore --id $SNAP --region eu --verify``
- Step 3: health checks: /healthz, sample inference.
- If route convergence >3m -> rollback.

maria: Add alerts: verifier fail (2 fails/24h) and route-convergence SLO breach.

kevin: I'll add the metric + propose SLO: 3m for warm-standby traffic shift.

anil: I'll add Grafana panels (last restore, verify pass rate) and hook alerts.

maria: Proposed dry-run: Wed 2026-03-11 09:00 PT 30 short window to exercise restore + routing. Can you hold?

kevin: +1

sasha: +1, will have pre-read runbook.

anil: +1, verifier in staging by then.

maria: Owners & dates recap:
- Routing guardrails: kevin 30 PR by 2026-03-06
- Restore runbook: sasha 30 draft by 2026-03-03
- Snapshot verifier: anil 30 staging by 2026-03-09
- DR dashboard baseline: kevin+anil 30 2026-03-10

maria: I'll open a GH project and post link. Update this thread with slipped ETAs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder set: DR dry-run on 2026-03-11 09:00 PT in #incidents.

kevin: I'll also draft a post-game one-pager to capture lessons right after the dry-run.

sasha: Adding cache warm-up to runbook so partial restores don't serve stale model shards.

anil: I'll add a quick automated verify step to the restore command in staging: ``./restore --id $SNAP --verify --smoke``

maria: Thanks all. Short, focused work should reduce recurrence. :rocket:
